notes.text: This infrastructure represents a exemple of what a private 4G/5G transport network looks like. To make it more simple, it only uses a single OSPF area for the entire dynamic routing. In the real life, it looks like this too but on the transport core network we will find BGP and sometime MPLS when the private xG network is deplyed over an entire city.
